source_identity: actual build SHA-256 bytes plus explicit Git blob comparison; inspect source_commit_binding.verified

final_sta_integrity.scope: fresh-process STA only of frozen physical database; no placement or route

sta.limitation: Classification covers reported final routed paths. A pass means every reported setup/hold/recovery/removal path met its constraint and every required clock/constraint health check was clean; it is not SDRAM AC validation or board/HDMI acceptance.

authorization.source: Direct user answer in this task; supersedes prior LUT 80 percent gate only
authorization.instruction: 允许超过 80%，但必须在器件容量内完成布局布线，并且全部时序通过，并且要尽可能占用少的资源，优化的越小越好。

resource_policy.note: Area acceptance alone never authorizes bitgen. Native packing limits and strict routed STA remain mandatory. Historical 80 percent results retain their original policy.

ram.note: A RAM32K macro consumes four of the physical RAM9K tiles.

bounded_asynchronous_outputs.scope: physical propagation bound, no synchronous external receiver assumed

ddc_absent_input.scope: only absent DDC DI and constant-zero data; CE/TS/reset retain normal STA, external pull-up/load pending hardware

pending_hardware: TMDS eye/jitter/channel skew and HDMI interoperability
in-package SDRAM read/write integrity and long-duration stability
